import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            list.add(x);
        }
        if (n == 0) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        Collections.sort(list);
        int index = (n - 1) / 2;
        System.out.println(list.get(index));
    }
}
